fixes.name: vk3DVision
fixes.pros: True Dual-View Rendering via Vulkan interception. No DX11 mode required.
fixes.cons: Experimental — vk3DVision has limited game support. Linux-first development.
fixes.notes: Launch the game in Vulkan mode. For SR Weave output: because vk3DVision is Vulkan-based, it cannot host ReShade directly. ShaderGlass creates a DX11 overlay window that ReShade can attach to, then 3DGameBridge routes the SBS output to the SR display.
